name: Le bassin
camera: from the glass doors, looking along the hydrotherapy pool

setting.walls: sea-green and white mosaic tiles with a glazed skylight roof overhead
setting.floor: wet pale stone around a clear turquoise pool
setting.landmark: the long therapy pool with a stone whale-head spout gently pouring water at the far end
setting.light: bright sky light from the glass roof, rippling water reflections
setting.style: S07 gentle storybook painterly 3.5/5 (one style for the whole Quartier de la Santé)

items.scene: PA's toy TRAIN ("pwah-TREEN") chugs right across a dad's broad CHEST as he floats on his back, puffing it out proudly.
A GORGEOUS ("GORZH") pelican with a flower behind its ear puffs out the big pouch under its THROAT.
A scruffy little CUR ("KUHR") dog floats on a big red HEART-shaped pool ring, hugging it tight.
A walrus floats on its back, its round BELLY warmed by the bubbling VENT ("VAHNTR") of the pool jet.
A swimmer takes a deep BREATH ("SOOFL") and puffs out her cheeks as round as the SOUFFLÉ on the poolside table.
A giant wooden chess PAWN ("PWAN") in swimming goggles raises a tiny FIST in victory at the pool's edge.
A garden-gnome DWARF ("DWAH") lifeguard on a tall chair wags one FINGER: no running by the pool!
A glowing PHONE ("FOHN") slips into the pool and sinks to the BOTTOM, and a duckling peers down at it through the clear water.

prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Le bassin in the B17_cabinet building, ground floor (garden wing). Camera: from the glass doors, looking along the hydrotherapy pool.
Setting: sea-green and white mosaic tiles with a glazed skylight roof overhead; floor: wet pale stone around a clear turquoise pool. Landmark: the long therapy pool with a stone whale-head spout gently pouring water at the far end. Light: bright sky light from the glass roof, rippling water reflections. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: the glass door frame and maple threshold in the near left foreground (way to La salle de gym).
Characters and objects, each a separate, clearly spaced group, feminine-word groups on the left half and masculine-word groups on the right half:
- far left, middle distance: PA's toy TRAIN chugs right across a dad's broad CHEST as he floats on his back, puffing it out proudly.
- left, foreground: A GORGEOUS pelican with a flower behind its ear has a whole fish bulging down its THROAT pouch.
- centre-left, middle distance: A scruffy little CUR dog floats on a big red HEART-shaped pool ring, hugging it tight.
- centre, foreground: A walrus floats on its back, its round BELLY warmed by the bubbling VENT of the pool jet.
- centre-right, middle distance: A swimmer takes a deep BREATH and puffs out her cheeks as round as the SOUFFLÉ on the poolside table.
- right, foreground: A giant wooden chess PAWN in swimming goggles raises a tiny FIST in victory at the pool's edge.
- far right, middle distance: A garden-gnome DWARF lifeguard on a tall chair wags one FINGER: no running by the pool!
- far right, foreground: A PHONE glows on the BOTTOM of the pool, and a duckling peers down at it through the clear water.
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
